seed: Objects of type `target` under action ACTION3 with touching neighbours [] show mixed outcomes: no_change x3, gone x1. Find the condition in the before state that decides the outcome. Start from this kind of condition: the presence, type or relative position of a neighbouring object. Verify it against every transition before you keep it.

synth.notes:
Player 5x5 steps 5 cells (A1-4); a dest box with wall 4 or void 5 is blocked but still burns budget. A colour-1 conveyor strip on a dest edge pushes the player away from it until blocked.
Every action burns 2 cells of the colour-11 bar (rows 61-62); fully covering a refuel ring consumes it and refills the bar.
Hypothesis resolved: target gone vs no_change = the player occludes the diamond (collect); it reappears when uncovered. Each cover rotates the HUD 3x3 glyph 90 deg CW.
Occlusion uses a continuity-gated underlay (frame minus player); stateless fallback paints the player bbox as floor (38/40 stateless).
Unconfirmed (unobserved here): recolor token sets glyph colour 9; legend chamber refuses entry for free while glyph != legend shape/colour.
